paraphrase.proposes: This track documents a stop rule for late findings in the measure-orchestrator skill. A round is one audit cycle on one audited HEAD, with parallel Reviews A/B/C sharing a round and the adversarial pass holding its own. A finding raised in round 3 or later goes to measure/tech-debt.md unless it passes a two-part test for a wrong result in delivered work. That finding gets one fix round, unless the Round limit blocks a third remediation round. The orchestrator records each call and its reason in the track plan under the current phase.
paraphrase.current_system: Per the spec, contracts.md holds the Re-review scope rule and the Round limit rule. Re-review scope keeps a kept routed finding and a defect in changed lines blocking, and treats other new findings as nonblocking. Round limit sends open findings to the user after the second remediation round for a base track, with an escalation key escape hatch for a third round. SKILL.md points to contracts.md under its Contracts section. The four named role files hold only re-review CONTEST handling and no round logic.
